name: research-disclosure
summary: Research agents read allow-listed PostgreSQL tables, share drafts in named internal Slack channels and open pull requests on named repositories: public and internal columns only, nothing posted to channels shared outside the organization, and every pull request to a public destination held for an approver.
covers: data classes: pii and secret columns are withheld, at most 100 rows a read
internal sharing: posts only to the named Slack channels, never to a channel shared outside the organization
public disclosure: every pull request through a public destination waits for an independent approver
a grant baseline covering reads, posts to the named channels and pull requests on the named repositories only
